title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: high-sampling-rate NREM sleep sEEG (normal high-frequency oscillations)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings of non-REM (N2/N3) sleep at the original sampling rates (512, 1024 and 2000 Hz) from 71 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy, taken from the MNI Open iEEG Atlas. Only bipolar channels judged to record normal activity (outside the epileptic zone and lesions, in grey matter) are included, with Talairach coordinates. The data were collected to characterize normative high-frequency oscillations (ripples) in the human brain.
methods_description: Clinical presurgical stereo-EEG recordings from three tertiary epilepsy centres, using DIXI and MNI homemade depth electrodes. Twenty-minute sections of N2/N3 sleep were selected. Bipolar derivations between adjacent contacts are positioned at the contact midpoint. Source int16 samples were repacked losslessly into BrainVision INT_16 with the source gain as resolution, and zero buffers between sections are listed in events.tsv.
